<!-- version: 2.51.1 -->
A small follow-up to yesterday's calendar release, with nothing to do by hand after the update.

The agenda used to skip today whenever there was nothing in it. The header said "From 28 August" and the first entry was the 29th, which looks less like a free day than like something failing to load. Today now appears with a quiet "Nothing planned".

Two smaller corrections in the calendar: the hint shown on an empty day is no longer cut in half by an hour line, and the view switcher now tells screen readers which part of the page it changes.

Full release notes are available at https://github.com/ulsklyc/yuvomi/releases/tag/v2.51.1
